title: TrackerSpokeSyncService
responsibility: Synchronize one Tracker link with the local spoke journal using signed batches and durable link-specific cursors.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.constructor.store
inputs.description: Local journal that atomically writes metadata and durably deduplicates applied operations by ID.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.constructor.transport
inputs.description: Sends an exact signed request to the configured link and rejects transport, timeout and HTTP failures.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.constructor.secret
inputs.description: Shared Tracker signing key in text or bytes.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.constructor.link
inputs.description: Selects the legacy hub or peer metadata keys. Defaults to hub.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.constructor.relayOps
inputs.description: Includes replicated origins in normal pushes. Defaults to true for a peer and false for a hub.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.constructor.pullWaitSeconds
inputs.description: Requested long-poll duration in seconds. Defaults to 25.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#acceptIdentity.dbId
inputs.description: Database identifier from the validated response.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#cursor.key
inputs.description: Legacy metadata key for the local push or remote pull sequence.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#request.request
inputs.description: HTTP method, exact path and query, and optional serialized body.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#request.timeoutMs
inputs.description: Request deadline in milliseconds.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.push
outputs.description: Count of operations acknowledged during this drain, including duplicates accepted by the receiver.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.pull
outputs.description: Applied page and cursor, a durable identity reset requiring replay and another poll, or a stale reply to discard.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#acceptIdentity
outputs.description: Whether a known database was replaced and its cursors reset.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#cursor
outputs.description: A nonnegative safe integer cursor, with zero for an absent value.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#request
outputs.description: Decoded JSON from the configured transport.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Push or pull rejects a failed transport, invalid sync data or failed journal operation. Retry from the durable cursor.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.push
outputs.description: Count of operations acknowledged during this drain, including duplicates accepted by the receiver.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects on an invalid receipt, invalid persisted cursor, failed transport or failed journal update. The unacknowledged batch remains eligible for retry.

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.pull
outputs.description: Applied page and cursor, a durable identity reset requiring replay and another poll, or a stale reply to discard.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects on an invalid page, invalid persisted cursor, failed transport or failed journal update. An unapplied page does not advance the cursor.

inputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#cursor.key

outputs.name: TrackerSpokeSyncService.#cursor
outputs.description: A nonnegative safe integer cursor, with zero for an absent value.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects corrupt cursor metadata that is not a nonnegative safe integer.
